##### Project general facts

Masaar 3 Layan by Arada is the fifth phase of the forested Masaar community, where homes blend gracefully with lush planting and open lawns. Stylish contemporary facades sit within a green landscape, while the homes rise from a ground floor to one or two upper levels. The collection offers townhouses with two to four bedrooms and spacious villas with four and five bedrooms, each with dedicated relaxation areas, a private lawn, shaded terraces and covered parking for the whole family.

Residents enjoy a picturesque garden with cascading waterfalls and a lagoon pool, a children's pool, a modern fitness centre and a yoga area. Basketball and padel courts, a volleyball area, an adventure playground, walking paths and sports areas encourage an active routine, while landscaped gardens and seating areas offer calm places to unwind. A community retail centre, cosy bistros and the Zad food trucks add convenient dining and shopping close to home.

Interiors combine high ceilings, refined finishes and layouts that maximise natural light and privacy, with smart home technology throughout. Every home includes living and dining areas, a maid's room, a laundry, dressing areas and a guest bathroom, while selected villas add private pools, majlis spaces, family rooms and home offices. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances including a cooking range, a hood and a washer-dryer, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and making each home easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Masaar is a forested master-planned community in Sharjah, where homes are set among tree-lined green corridors, parks and shaded walking and cycling paths. Community pools, sports courts, play areas, cafes, a mosque and a community centre create a calm, family-oriented setting, while Masaar Central adds retail, dining and everyday services within easy reach of every neighbourhood.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road connect residents with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Masaar Central, Tilal Mall, Nasma Central Park and the Sharjah Mosque are a short drive away, while Sharjah International Airport, University City and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance, along with schools, clinics and hospitals serving local families.

Masaar is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the best-selling green residential destinations in the UAE. Spacious villas and townhouses surrounded by nature attract families seeking more space at accessible prices compared with Dubai. Low service charges, an established community and strong road links support steady demand from end users and tenants, underpinning long-term value for owners and investors.
